name: NOK Group Corporation
summary: NOK Group Corporation engages in manufacturing and selling industrial functional products in Japan and internationally. The company provides solutions in the fields of Sealing, Mechanical, Electronics, and Chemical. It offers sealing solutions, such as oil seals, O-rings, and others; mechanical solutions, including mechanical seals, valves, and accumulators; electronics solutions comprising flexible printed circuits; and chemical solutions, such as specialty lubricants, synthetic rubber, and others. It serves various industries in automotive, electronic products, industrial machinery, aviation and aerospace, marine vessels, nuclear power and energy, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment.…
